turns.doctor_question: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi Dr. Smith. It's really nice to meet you, and um, thank you so much for seeing me. I hope I'm in the right place for this. 

I guess I came in because... well, I've just been having a little bit of trouble keeping things organized lately. It's not a huge disaster or anything! I just feel like I can't get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. I try really hard to keep on top of it, but my shop supplies, my receipts, and then my assignment notes and due dates... they all sort of just end up in these big piles. And then I look at it all and I just don't know what to do first. 

Is that... does that make sense? I hope that's an okay reason to be here.
